note: DECISIONS「画质」: the 设置 page's 画质 levels. high is the game as it was drawn before the setting (Godot's soft-low shadow filter, a 4096 sun shadow in four splits, 4x MSAA, the eight nearest lamps casting); low trades the shadows' soft edges, the sun shadow's detail, smooth edges and four lamps' shadows for the frame. steam_deck: the level a Steam Deck starts on (the environment variable Steam sets there, or one of its GPU names; whatever the system: the Windows build runs on a Deck through Proton). slow_hint: told once, while on high, after this many seconds in a row each slower than this frame rate, once the map has been up for settle_seconds.
